decisions.decision: Build it end to end now. In all 16 FunnelOS files, replace every Apollo reference with the bought-list model (T-056). Use the plain label 'Lead list' (subtext: 'bought list, imported into Tantra'). Remove 'apollo' from every logos array and keep 'tantra'. Do not put a list vendor's name or logo there, because no vendor is confirmed. Delete the apollo id from the logo map in funnel-os.tsx and add 'apollo' to BANNED in app/scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs. Leave the tools that T-260 still has to rule on as they are. Check: git grep -i -w apollo -- app/src/components/masterclass must return nothing, probe-visual-tools.mjs must pass, and probe-funnel-boards.mjs must report ALL BOARDS FIT at 1440/1024/760/390/350. Fix any overflow before shipping. Commit to main, publish the mirror through Lane A, run the probes again on the mirror, then move the task to review for Adi with the full links to /funnels/<id> and playbook.html#funnels.
decisions.why: approved-vendor-stack and vendor-accounts-no-change-rule both rule Apollo out (2026-10-07) and say lists come from data vendors (T-056). The spec says exactly what to change, and nothing in it needs Adi. orchestrator-autonomy (2026-10-09) approves pushes to our own systems and mirror publishes.
